description: Master bus for the older cable-linked Daisy Mix chain, restoring the daisy signal to full level and sending it to one mono output

params.text: Sets the level of the mix, silence fully left, 0dB at noon and +6dB fully right

inputs.text: Scales the mix level, 0-10V for silence to the MASTER setting, with voltage outside that range clamped
Takes the daisy signal from the last channel strip in the chain

outputs.text: The daisy signal multiplied by sixteen to undo the scaling the strips applied, clamped to -12V to 12V before the MASTER knob and the level CV are applied

notes: This module is hidden from the module browser and stays for patches built before the touching-module Daisy Mix master
